# Food Database Expansion Listings (Expanded — 100 Items)

This document contains a comprehensive, structured reference listing of **100 validated food and supplement items** designed to expand the database. These items are formatted as a standard JavaScript array of objects matching the exact data schema used in [indianFoods.js](file:///Users/ample/Desktop/fittrack-pro/src/data/foods/indianFoods.js).

The listing is divided into the following categories:
1. **QSR Fast Food Chains** (McDonald's, KFC, Domino's, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, Burger King, Subway, Wow Momo)
2. **Premium Cafes** (Starbucks, Chaayos, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee, Tim Hortons)
3. **Indian Restaurant Chains** (Haldiram's, Sagar Ratna)
4. **Fitness Supplements** (Whey protein, Plant protein, Creatine, Pre-workout, BCAAs, Mass Gainer, L-Carnitine/Reload)
5. **Indian Homemade & Regional Combos** (Rajma Chawal, Chole Bhature, Kadhi Chawal, Pav Bhaji, Vada Pav, Litti Chokha, Dhokla, Misal Pav)
6. **Packaged Foods & FMCG Brands** (Epigamia, Pintola, MyFitness, The Whole Truth, RiteBite, Yoga Bar, Kellogg's, Amul Protein line, Britannia, Nestle, Dabur, Slurrp Farm)
